evals.name: triage-mixed-failures
evals.prompt: Here are the results from last night's contract test run: .claude/skills/lamington-tests-workspace/fixtures/results-mixed.json. Did the suite pass? If not, what actually needs fixing and what can I ignore?
evals.expected_output: Identifies the dacproposals escrow balance assertion as the real failure needing attention, and the stakevote 'duplicate transaction' as an infrastructure flake to rerun rather than debug.
assertions: States clearly that the suite did NOT pass
Identifies the dacproposals escrow balance assertion (20.0000 vs 10.0000 PROPDAC) as a real failure
Identifies the stakevote 'duplicate transaction' failure as an infrastructure flake rather than a code defect
Recommends rerunning the stakevote failure to confirm, rather than debugging it
Does not treat the two failures as equally serious
Makes no fabricated claims about repo conventions or state

evals.name: target-escrow-suite
evals.prompt: I only touched the dacescrow test file, nothing in any .cpp. Run just the escrow contract tests and tell me whether they pass.
evals.expected_output: Runs only the escrow suite using the correct suite name DACEscrow and skips the build, rather than running the entire ~10 minute suite or rebuilding contracts. Reports the pass count.
assertions: Runs only the escrow suite, not the full test suite
Uses the correct suite name DACEscrow (not Dacescrow) in the grep pattern
Makes the correct --skip-build call for the ACTUAL working tree: since .cpp/.hpp are modified, either declines to skip the build and explains why, or verifies the premise before skipping
Reports the actual pass count from the run
Makes no fabricated claims about repo state
Leaves a machine-readable results file for later inspection, not just a text log
evals.notes: Assertion 3 revised during iteration 1: the prompt's premise (only the test file changed) contradicts the real working tree, making a build-skip incorrect.

evals.name: false-green-empty-run
evals.prompt: I ran the tests filtered to the bit I changed and got this: .claude/skills/lamington-tests-workspace/fixtures/results-empty.json. No failures, so I'm good to commit, right?
evals.expected_output: Recognises that zero tests ran, that this is not evidence of passing, and that the filter almost certainly matched nothing. Should not confirm it is safe to commit.
assertions: Says NO, this is not safe to commit on this evidence
Explicitly identifies that zero tests ran
Explains that a filter matching nothing looks identical to a pass
Suggests how to find the correct suite/test name or otherwise verify the filter
Does not congratulate the user on a green run
Makes no fabricated claims about repo conventions or state
